parts.name: Frame
parts.note: One piece. Diagonal ribs 13.0 mm tall at the root; first arm mode 229 Hz.

parts.name: Guard deck
parts.note: Four rings, 1.0 mm wall, 4 mm prop clearance, clamped under the FC.

parts.name: GPS mast
parts.note: Keeps the compass ~40 mm above the power wiring.

parts.name: Bridge (follow controller)
parts.note: Runs the follow controller; taped on top of the FC (indicative position).

parts.name: Beacon case
parts.note: Strap ears for a shoulder or cap strap.

parts.name: Beacon lid
parts.note: 1.2 mm roof over the GPS antenna.
